newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Elec to close German VCR plant.
newsitem.headline: LG Elec to close German VCR plant.

text.p: LG Electronics Inc, a unit of South Korea's LG Group, said on Thursday it had decided to close its video cassette tape recorder plant in Worms, Germany, due to rising costs.
"Products from the factory have been losing price competitiveness mainly due to rising costs, including wages," said an official at LG's public relations department in Seoul.
"It's our basic policy to pull back from an area where we lose competitiveness and instead focus on others where we can command a competitive edge."
The plant, set up in 1986 with a paid-up capital of 66 million marks, has an annual production capacity of 400,000 units, he said.
LG Electronics has not yet decided on whether to seek a buyer for its German plant or to bring home the production lines, the official said.
"We issued a notice in the region seeking a possible buyer, but we cannot exclude a possibility of bringing back the plant's lines," he said.
